meta.title: Help centre · Clafina
meta.description: The complete guide to Clafina: every module and every page, step by step, in the words the app uses.

hero.title: How do you want to get it done?
hero.lede: The guide to every part of Clafina, in the same words and the same order as the app's own menu. Search for a task, or open the part of the business you work in.
hero.search: Search the guide, for example: send an invoice

start: Sign up and create your organisation with its first location. Your books start ready: your currency, a chart of accounts for your country and the current year.
Add your products and their prices in Products.
Invite your team from People and access, and give each person a role.
Make your first sale: an invoice in Sales, or a sale at the till.
Open the Dashboard each morning: how the business is doing today, and what needs you.
everyPage: Every page, in the menu's order
numbers: How the numbers are worked out
noResults: Nothing matches yet. Try fewer words, or open the part of Clafina below.

stillStuck.title: Still stuck?
stillStuck.body: In the app, press Help on any page. It explains that page, lets you ask the Assistant, and sends a case to our team with what you were looking at.
